title: Persona 4 Revival Game's Videos Highlight Kanji, Yosuke, Chie, Yukiko
content: Atlus revealed new character videos for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, in July and August, and a new video for Kanji on Saturday. The videos below feature Kanji, Yosuke, Chie, and Yukiko respectively.
author: ANN

title: Wandance Gets Stage Play in March 2027
content: A website opened on Saturday to announce Coffee 's Wandance manga is getting a stage play titled Wandance on Stage from March 19-28 at the MoN Takanawa: The Museum of Narratives Box1000 in Tokyo. THE JET BOY BANGERZ from Exile Tribe member Taki will star as Kaboku. Imagine Itо̄ will direct and write the script.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Unnamed Memory: After the End' Concludes with Eighth Volume
content: The official X of Kadokawa's Dengeki no Shinbungei label announced on August 27 that Kuji Furumiya and chibi 's Unnamed Memory: After the End light novel series will end with its eighth volume on December 17.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kuji Furumiya's Unnamed Memory -after the end- Sequel Light Novel Series Ends in December
content: Dengeki Bunko will also publish an art book titled Unnamed Memory Archives - chibi art works- in December. Furumiya ( A Pale Moon Reverie , Babel ) began serializing the Unnamed Memory story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in September 2012, but the story is no longer available on the platform.
author: ANN

title: Medabots S Smartphone Game to Get Global Launch
content: Imagineer announced on Friday that it will release the Medabots S game for iOS and Android devices globally and opened pre-registrations for the game. The game's App Store page lists its release date as January 21, 2027. The game launched in Japan under the title Medarot S: Unlimited Nova in January 2020.
author: ANN

title: Kana Delays Inio Asano's Before Dawn and the End of the World Manga to March 4
content: Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint announced on Friday that it will publish Inio Asano 's short story manga colleciton Before Dawn and the End of the World ( Sekai no Owari to Yoake Mae ) on the new date of March 4.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Posts Miracle Light Trailer, Teases More Precures' Future Forms
content: The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — presented the film's Pochitan Miracle Light trailer on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: 5 Years Later, The Director of Marvel’s Underrated Flop Defends Comic Book Movies and “Loved” Being in the MCU
content: The Marvel Cinematic Universe has grown and changed in ways that no one could have predicted. Now, 18 years and 38 films later, this interconnected continuity feels bigger than it ever has, and Kevin Feige and the other Marvel executives don’t plan on stopping anytime soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer Unveils New Look At Zenitsu After His Biggest Fight in Infinity Castle
content: Even more than a year after the premiere of the first installment, Demon Slayer still hasn’t shared any updates on the upcoming movies. The anime was already a global phenomenon, but it reached new heights of popularity last year with the Infinity Castle movie.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super’s New Remake Release Schedule Means Bad News for the Moro Arc
content: Dragon Ball Super is coming back this Fall with a brand new enhanced version of the original TV anime , but its release schedule might be bad news as fans will likely have to wait much longer than they hoped for the new Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc adaptation.
author: ComicBook
